newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates remain at high levels.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates remain at high levels.

text.p: Pakistani money market overnight rates remained at high levels throughout Wednesday owing to a shortage of funds, dealers said.
The rates are likely to open at higher side on Monday after four holidays for the Moslem Eid al-Adha festival holiday, one dealer said.
Trades for overnight funds started at 19.50 percent and heavy amounts were dealt around 19 percent, a dealer of KASB & Co said. The rates closed at 19.50 percent.
